capabilities: Convert images to JPEG from the reading-view context menu
Convert images to WebP from the reading-view context menu
Convert images to PNG from the reading-view context menu
disambiguation: Not an image editor or viewer; it only converts image file formats via a right-click menu.
extras: The README's credits section is truncated: it says the plugin reuses functions from another unnamed plugin and includes a Ko-fi donation link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert an embedded image's file format from within the app.
summary: Context-menu plugin that converts images in reading view to JPEG, WebP or PNG.
